decision: not adopted; cutoff removed from normal source
baselineDescription: current deferred multi-issuer candidate, not main
candidateDescription: skip optional hints for files smaller than 4 KiB; keep existing per-file/tree caps, cloning, verification and journal behavior

eligibility.note: calculated from fixture file sizes, not traced syscalls

caveats: Local loaded host; not an independent hosted result. All observations and outliers are retained.
Both executables were built before timing. No stack observer, stage probes, other local build or benchmark overlapped.
The 4 KiB cutoff preserves admission for the existing 8 KiB synthetic fixture; it cannot be claimed to address the earlier regression on that unchanged workload.
Both baseline and candidate had long delays before hints began; phase receipts include journal persistence and do not establish a cause.
Cargo removed 4.4 GiB of this task's rebuildable development artifacts before the candidate build due to disk pressure. Release binaries, source and existing evidence were preserved.
A hosted evaluation was prepared but not launched after the completed local result provided no whole-startup or CPU benefit.
These observations do not resolve the earlier hosted concurrent timeout.
